data.title: The Acres
data.about:
Explore The Acres by Meraas, an exclusive community featuring 3 to 5-bedroom standalone villas. Inspired by nature, the villa development is surrounded by tranquil gardens and swimmable lagoons. Each home has expansive living areas, floor-to-celing windows, and an array of environmentally friendly features.

The community features Halo Loop Park which provides a wide range of leisure activities for all. Residents benefit from convenient access to a nursery, school, clinic, mosques, clubhouses, and a retail area, along with over 2,000 square meters of the Edible Garden. 

Nearly one-third of the community’s roads are dedicated to pedestrians and cyclists. Wellness is further supported by monitoring outdoor air quality and offering ample natural shades.

• Bespoke Villas: Custom-designed 3 to 5-bedroom standalone villas that offer a blend of luxury and privacy, tailored to your lifestyle needs.
  • Nature-Infused Living: Surrounded by lush parks and serene swimmable lagoons, The Acres provides a tranquil, nature-centric living environment.
  • Halo Loop Park: A unique, pedestrian-friendly park that seamlessly connects the community, offering a safe and vibrant environment with abundant green spaces.
  • Sustainability Commitment: Meraas’ dedication to eco-friendly living is highlighted by their aim to achieve LEED Gold certification, setting high standards for sustainability, energy efficiency, and water conservation.
  • Proximity to Major Attractions: Just minutes away from Global Village, Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, and
  • Hamdan Sports Complex, offering residents a variety of leisure and entertainment options.
  • Community-Centric Design: Thoughtfully planned natural park features and recreational areas that foster a strong sense of community and enhance the overall living experience.

location_tile.title: Enjoy a Modern Lifestyle in the Heart of the City
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The Acres by Meraas is strategically situated in the heart of Dubailand, offering unparalleled connectivity to key areas across Dubai. With direct access to major thoroughfares like Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street and Emirates Road, residents enjoy effortless commutes to the city's most sought-after destinations. Whether heading to work, exploring Dubai's vibrant attractions, or simply running daily errands, The Acres provides a seamless experience that enhances the convenience of modern living.

Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club - 5 minutes
Hamdan Sports Complex - 5 minutes
Global Village - 10 minutes
Dubai Autodrome - 15 minutes
IMG Worlds of Adventure - 15 minutes
Mall of the Emirates - 20 minutes
Dubai Marina - 25 minutes
